aboutSubtitle: The purpose and approach behind Operations Radar.
aboutIntro: Operations Radar is a local operations dashboard that helps make order-delay risks visible. It analyzes order data, helps teams identify priorities, and supports earlier action. The project is currently a development MVP.

aboutPrinciples.title: See what needs attention
aboutPrinciples.text: Risk scores and operational signals help you spot orders that may need review.

aboutPrinciples.title: Make data easier to explore
aboutPrinciples.text: Trend and segment views help you examine the current order pool from different angles.

aboutPrinciples.title: Keep decisions with your team
aboutPrinciples.text: Predictions provide decision support; they are not guaranteed to be calibrated and do not replace operational judgment.

contactSubtitle: Channels for questions, feedback, and collaboration.
contactIntro: For questions, feedback, or collaboration ideas about Operations Radar, you can reach out through the channels below.
contactWaysDescription: Choose the channel that works best for your message.
privacyIntro: Operations Radar is designed as a local development MVP. This page summarizes the current application behavior and should be reviewed if its deployment or infrastructure changes.

privacySections.title: Data uploaded to the application
privacySections.text: CSV files are sent to the running application server for analysis. According to the project documentation, uploaded CSV data is not saved to disk. Before using real or sensitive data, verify the data flow and retention settings of your own environment.

privacySections.title: Preference stored in your browser
privacySections.text: Your language preference is stored in the browser's local storage and is used to remember the interface language.

privacySections.title: Third-party services
privacySections.text: When Ollama is enabled and used, relevant operational data may be sent to the configured local Ollama service to generate an AI summary. The deployment and retention terms of that service apply.

privacySections.title: Using the application safely
privacySections.text: This release may require additional security, access-control, and compliance review before production use. Assess your deployment before uploading personal or confidential data.

termsSubtitle: What to keep in mind when using Operations Radar.
termsIntro: Operations Radar is a development MVP for operational analysis. Please keep the following limitations and responsibilities in mind when using it.

termsSections.title: Information and predictions
termsSections.text: Risk scores are model predictions, not certain outcomes, guarantees, or causal explanations for individual orders. Do not make important decisions based solely on these scores.

termsSections.title: Data and your responsibilities
termsSections.text: Make sure you are authorized to use the data you upload and that it meets applicable security and privacy requirements. Review the necessary controls before using this MVP with sensitive or production data.

termsSections.title: Development release
termsSections.text: The application is provided for development and evaluation; uninterrupted operation or any particular outcome is not promised. AI feature availability depends on a local Ollama installation.

termsSections.title: Scope of these terms
termsSections.text: This page describes the current development release and is not legal advice. Review the terms and applicable regulatory requirements before deploying the application or using it in an organization.
